name: Armor of Valor
text: * Valor 1: After this Phoenixborn is dealt damage while guarding or resolving its ability, prevent 1 damage from being received.

name: Bravery
text: You may play this spell after a unit you control is dealt damage. Prevent that damage from being received.

name: Divinity Mount
text:
Lightning Breath 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may deal 1 damage to all units a target opponent controls.

* Queen Rider: When this unit is destroyed, place 3 wounds on your Phoenixborn.

name: Fork Lightning
text: Choose two target units an opponent controls. If you do, deal 1 damage to each targeted unit.

name: Glory Aspirant
text: Lionize: When this unit comes into play, search your draw pile. You may reveal a card with a [[divine:power]] in its play cost and place it into your hand. Shuffle your draw pile. Then, change 1 divine die in your active pool to a side of your choice.

name: Hand of Shield
text: Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

name: Hand of Spear
text:
Raise Shield: When this unit comes into play, place a [[Hand of Shield]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Quick Strike: While this unit is attacking, it deals its damage before units in battle with it.

name: Intercession
text:
You may play this spell after an opponent declares an attacker that is targeting a unit you control. Choose another unit you control to gain the following abilities for the remainder of the turn:

Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

Alert: Do not place exhaustion tokens on this unit as a result of its countering.

name: Pride
text:
When attaching this spell to a unit you control, you may choose a divine die in your exhausted pool and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

* This unit now has the following ability:

* Pride: This unit cannot be guarded or guarded against.

name: Ptera Hatchling
text: Shock 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, if its current attack value is greater than its printed attack value, you may deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls.

name: Ptera Herder
text: Call Ptera Hatchling: When this unit comes into play, place a [[Ptera Hatchling]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Radiant Light
text:
When this spell comes into play, you may choose a divine die in your exhausted pool and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

While a divine die is on a unit you control, its life value and recover value are increased by 1.

* Flicker: Shuffle this card into your draw pile at the end of the round.

name: Shining Stag Mount
text:
Armed: When this unit comes into play, you may choose a divine die in your exhausted pool and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

* Dismount: When this unit is destroyed, place any allies you own underneath this unit into your hand.

name: Silver Paladin
text:
Smite 1: When this unit comes into play, you may destroy a target unit an opponent controls with an attack value of 1 or less.

Exalt: After this unit destroys a unit an opponent controls during your turn, you may choose a divine die in your exhausted pool and resolve its dice power without paying its cost.

name: Soulfire
text:
Search your discard pile for up to 3 allies and remove them from the game. For each ally removed, resolve the following effect:

Choose a player. Deal 1 damage to a target unit they control, or deal 1 damage to their target Phoenixborn if they control no units.

name: Summon Shining Stag Mount
text: [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[divine:class]] - 1 [[basic]]: Remove an unexhausted ally you control from play. If you do, place a [[Shining Stag Mount]] conjuration onto your battlefield, placing that ally face down underneath it.

name: Take to the Skies
text: If your Phoenixborn is exhausted, place a [[Divinity Mount]] conjuration onto your battlefield.
